purpose: Focused native-only Prometheus-parity validation corpus for classic histogram quantile support over grouped/rate-fed bucket inputs.
notes: Exercises histogram_quantile on canonical grouped/rate-fed classic histogram bucket inputs.
Uses baseline and histogram_burst dataset variants to catch bucket-shape regressions.

Other classic-histogram helper functions added in native SQL are currently covered by unit/native-renderer tests; Prometheus result parity over those classic bucket-only shapes is not yet used as a harness gate here.
